review_notes: Read both original code files in full and assessed the fixed 89 static leaves individually, without using prior testcase or Host scores.
Whole-build obstacles do not cause blanket zeroing. Missing actual hardware interfaces, real-time algorithms, or required functionality are judged from implementation evidence.
The 13 leaves excluded in advance for performance/hardware dependencies or unclear scope remain unassessed. This candidate did not change the denominator.
Consistency review: OS-R043 was changed from fully_covered to partially_covered; the initial report and correction audit are retained.
Reviewed the common R+D boundary: valid host simulation is not downgraded for missing physical hardware; conflicts remain uncertain, with denominator 89 and 13 unassessed unchanged.
